{{Quote|I remember. My brother died in the conflict. His ship came out of hyperspace in the center of a sun.|Armand Isard remembers his brother|<ref name="AotE1" />}}
[[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] had a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''brother''' who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]]<ref name="AotE1" /> in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="shw" /> During the conflict, which was fought against the [[Stark Commercial Combine]], the leader of the Combine, [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]], released a [[Navcomputer virus]] into the [[Navigation computer/Legends|Navigation computers]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. The [[Armand Isard's brother's ship|ship]] on which Isard's brother was serving was one of those affected, and it was destroyed when it came out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] into a [[Star/Legends|star]] while en route to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]]. Isard's brother perished in the crash and the director would later remember his brother's fate in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], when discussing the war with [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Jahan Cross]].<ref name="AotE1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Armand Isard's brother was first mentioned in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]], which was written by [[John Ostrander]] as part of the "[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse|Iron Eclipse]]" story arc of the ''[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire]]'' series.
